Version 1.0.1 of "marriott-hotel-booking" contains no changes compared to the previous version.

- No updates or modifications were detected in this release.
- All functionality and documentation remain unchanged.

- Initial release of "万豪酒店预订" skill for searching and booking Marriott Group hotels.
- Supports live price and booking link retrieval from the Feizhu official Marriott section.
- Enables detailed hotel info lookup, including facilities and room types, and searches for bundled package offers.
- Strictly displays only original script output data; no modifications or additions allowed.
- Provides user-friendly sample workflows for hotel search, details inquiry, and package deals.
